A quiet stay in the old city

Lahore Fort Guest House is a small guest house near Lahore Fort, made for travellers who have come to see the historic heart of Lahore. With just two rooms, every guest gets a personal, unhurried welcome.

Step out and you are moments from the Fort's great gates and the lanes of the Walled City. Step back in and you have a cool, comfortable room with everything you need for a good night's rest — free WiFi, an Inverter AC, a Smart LED TV and secure parking.

Cultural tours can be arranged, so the stories behind the city around you are never far away.
